chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Yaḥyā al-Ḥalabī, from Ibn Miskān, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) left among his chattels a sword, a coat of mail, a spear, a saddle, and his grey mule; so ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (عليه السلام) inherited all of that.

key_terms.دِرْعًا: a coat of mail or shield armor
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, Prophet Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم)

ai.seo_question: What did Rasool-Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) leave behind, and who inherited his belongings?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Rasool-Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) left certain personal possessions and war equipment, and that all of them were inherited by ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (عليه السلام). It reflects the transmission of the Prophet’s belongings to Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام) and is cited within the discussion of what remained with the Imams from the relics of Rasool-Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله).

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu baser, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> left behind among the chattels, a sword, and a shield, and a spear, and a saddle, and a grey mule. So all of that was inherited by Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya al-Halabi from ibn Muskan from abu Basir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Of the legacy that the Messenger of Allah left was a sword, a coat of arms, a spears, a saddle and a gray mule. Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) inherited all of them.”
